meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Pairs with a deployment skill such as vercel-cli, where one is installed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确保每个网页项目在交付前都通过构建、测试与真实浏览器验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是前端开发者,希望每个网页项目在交付前都得到系统性验证。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure every web project passes build, test, and real-browser verification before delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a frontend developer wanting a systematic verification workflow before delivering web projects.

howto.what: Claude 会按固定流程处理前端任务:先阅读现有代码,再编写 TypeScript,然后构建、在真实浏览器中打开页面并截图,确认无报错、无溢出、可响应、可访问后才宣布完成,最后部署并验证线上地址。
howto.when: 当你要求它搭建、修改或部署网页项目,或让它检查某个前端页面的实际效果时,它会接管并按此流程执行。

say.text: 帮我用 React 做一个响应式登录页,完成后截图给我看。
say.note: 会按流程构建并在浏览器中验证截图。

say.text: 检查这个页面在桌面和平板下有没有布局问题,截图对比。
say.note: 会启动浏览器调整尺寸并截图检查。

say.text: 改完这个组件后重新构建,并部署到线上验证效果。
say.note: 会先本地构建再部署并验证生产地址。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow a strict workflow for frontend tasks: read existing code, write TypeScript, build, open the page in a real browser, take screenshots, confirm no console errors or layout overflow, ensure responsiveness and accessibility, then deploy and verify the live URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to create, modify, or deploy a web project, or when you want it to check how a frontend page actually looks and behaves in a browser.

say_en.text: Build me a responsive login page in React, then show me a screenshot when done.
say_en.note: It will build and verify with a browser screenshot.

say_en.text: Check this page on desktop and tablet for layout issues, and compare screenshots.
say_en.note: It will resize the browser and capture screenshots.

say_en.text: After editing this component, rebuild, deploy to production, and verify the live site.
say_en.note: It will build locally, deploy, and verify the production URL.
